import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict, Any

def inspect_pci_option_roms(pci_sysfs_root: str = "/sys/bus/pci/devices") -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Inspects PCI expansion ROMs in read-only mode, verifying the 0xAA55 signature."""
    pci_dir = Path(pci_sysfs_root)
    rom_reports = []
    if not pci_dir.exists():
        return rom_reports

    for dev_path in sorted(pci_dir.glob("*")):
        rom_node = dev_path / "rom"
        if rom_node.exists() and os.access(rom_node, os.R_OK):
            try:
                with open(rom_node, "rb") as f:
                    header = f.read(2)
                    has_valid_sig = (header == b"\x55\xaa")
                    rom_reports.append({
                        "device_id": dev_path.name,
                        "rom_readable": True,
                        "has_valid_signature": has_valid_sig,
                    })
            except (PermissionError, OSError):
                continue
    return rom_reports<|im_end|>

"""Fedora dnf5 Transaction Inspection and Safe Rollback Utility."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys

def run_cmd(args):
    res = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    return res.stdout

def inspect_last_transaction():
    raw_json = run_cmd(["dnf5", "history", "list", "--limit", "1", "--json"])
    data = json.loads(raw_json)
    tx = data["transactions"][0]
    print(f"Latest Transaction: #{tx['id']} | Action: {tx['cmdline']} | Timestamp: {tx['timestamp']}")
    return tx['id']

def execute_safe_rollback(tx_id: int):
    print(f"Executing dry-run rollback for transaction #{tx_id}...")
    # Dry-run validation first
    run_cmd(["dnf5", "history", "undo", str(tx_id), "--assumeno"])
    print("Dry-run passed without dependency breaks. Executing undo...")
    run_cmd(["dnf5", "history", "undo", str(tx_id), "--assumeyes"])
    print(f"Transaction #{tx_id} successfully rolled back.")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    tid = inspect_last_transaction()
    # Execute rollback on request
    if '--rollback' in sys.argv:
        execute_safe_rollback(tid)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Diagnostic parser for git worktree --porcelain with automated hygiene."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

def inspect_worktrees():
    cmd = ["git", "worktree", "list", "--porcelain"]
    res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    
    worktrees = []
    cur = {}
    for line in res.stdout.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            if cur:
                worktrees.append(cur)
                cur = {}
            continue
        parts = line.split(" ", 1)
        k = parts[0]
        v = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else True
        if k == 'worktree':
            if cur:
                worktrees.append(cur)
                cur = {}
            cur['path'] = v
        elif k == 'HEAD':
            cur['head'] = v
        elif k == 'branch':
            cur['branch'] = v
        elif k == 'locked':
            cur['locked'] = True
            cur['lock_reason'] = v
        elif k == 'prunable':
            cur['prunable'] = v

    if cur:
        worktrees.append(cur)

    print(f"Found {len(worktrees)} active worktree registration(s):")
    for wt in worktrees:
        exists = Path(wt['path']).exists()
        print(f"  • Path: {wt['path']} (Exists: {exists}) | Branch: {wt.get('branch', 'DETACHED')}")
        if wt.get('locked'):
            print(f"    [LOCKED] Reason: {wt.get('lock_reason')}")

    # Prune stale metadata
    subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "prune", "--verbose"], check=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    inspect_worktrees()<|im_end|>

export interface ServiceStatus {
  readonly nodeVersion: string;
  readonly uptimeSeconds: number;

    severity: LogSeverity.INFO,

  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
  res.end(JSON.stringify(status));

using System.Buffers.Binary;
using System.Diagnostics;

public class PacketDecoder
{
    public static bool TryParseHeader(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data, out ushort magic, out ushort length)
    {
        magic = 0;
        length = 0;
        // Strict boundary check before reading 4-byte header
        if (data.Length < 4) return false;

        magic = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(data.Slice(0, 2));
        length = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(data.Slice(2, 2));

        // Check if data contains full announced payload
        if (data.Length < 4 + length) return false;

        return true;
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        byte[] validPacket = new byte[] { 0xCA, 0xFE, 0x00, 0x02, 0x11, 0x22 };
        bool ok = PacketDecoder.TryParseHeader(validPacket, out var magic, out var length);
        Debug.Assert(ok && magic == 0xCAFE && length == 2);

        byte[] truncatedPacket = new byte[] { 0xCA, 0xFE, 0x00 };
        ok = PacketDecoder.TryParseHeader(truncatedPacket, out _, out _);

using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Threading;

public class SafeResource : IDisposable
{
    private int _isDisposed;

    public void DoWork()
    {
        if (Volatile.Read(ref _isDisposed) == 1)
        {
            throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(SafeResource));
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        // Atomic compare exchange ensures idempotency
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _isDisposed, 1) == 0)
        {
            // Free unmanaged resources safely
            GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
        }
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        var res = new SafeResource();
        res.DoWork();

        // Safe multiple calls
        res.Dispose();
        res.Dispose();

        bool caught = false;
        try
        {
            res.DoWork();
        }
        catch (ObjectDisposedException)
        {
            caught = true;
        }
        Debug.Assert(caught);
        Console.WriteLine("CSHARP DPO 0006 Chosen: Idempotent disposal pattern verified.");
    }
}<|im_end|>

#include <stdio.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <assert.h>

#define NUM_THREADS 4
#define ITERS_PER_THREAD 10000

typedef struct {
    long long value;
    pthread_mutex_t lock;
} safe_counter_t;

void safe_counter_init(safe_counter_t *c) {
    c->value = 0;
    pthread_mutex_init(&c->lock, NULL);
}

void safe_counter_inc(safe_counter_t *c) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&c->lock);
    c->value++;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&c->lock);
}

long long safe_counter_get(safe_counter_t *c) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&c->lock);
    long long val = c->value;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&c->lock);
    return val;
}

void *worker(void *arg) {
    safe_counter_t *c = (safe_counter_t *)arg;
    for (int i = 0; i < ITERS_PER_THREAD; i++) {
        safe_counter_inc(c);
    }
    return NULL;
}

int main(void) {
    safe_counter_t counter;
    safe_counter_init(&counter);

    pthread_t threads[NUM_THREADS];
    for (int i = 0; i < NUM_THREADS; i++) {
        pthread_create(&threads[i], NULL, worker, &counter);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < NUM_THREADS; i++) {
        pthread_join(threads[i], NULL);
    }

    assert(safe_counter_get(&counter) == (NUM_THREADS * ITERS_PER_THREAD));
    pthread_mutex_destroy(&counter.lock);
    printf("C DPO 0001 Chosen: Counter = %lld (exact match)\n", counter.value);
    return 0;
}<|im_end|>

    struct dnode *next;

void list_remove_node(dnode_t **head, dnode_t *node) {
